dedupe_keys.name: filtered and validated irish energy performance certificate ber dataset

description: This dataset is a filtered version of Ireland's Energy Performance Certificate (Building Energy Rating) database for residential buildings, produced by Kumar Raushan and co-authors to remove erroneous entries and outliers with a standardised, data-driven validation method. The authors note that the public Irish EPC database holds over one million unfiltered entries with inconsistent and erroneous values that can bias analysis; the processed file keeps validated certificates with 213 variables grouped as informational, thermophysical, geometric and system attributes, and the Python processing scripts and supplementary notes document the filtering steps and experimental design. The work is described in a Data in Brief article of April 2025 ('Filtered dataset of Irish energy performance certificates: a data-driven approach for enhanced building stock modelling'), which links the Mendeley dataset, the GitHub script and the SEAI BER research tool as sources. Coverage: residential buildings in Ireland with certificates up to the July 2023 extract named in the file. Access: one CSV of about 843 MB on Mendeley Data, version 1 of 15 March 2024. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a derived snapshot, not updated with new certificates, and filtering choices remove records that other users might keep. Simulation uses: archetype definition, stock energy modelling and retrofit scenario inputs for Irish housing. Related records: the SEAI BER research tool (the source database) and the Dublin building energy profiles dataset.
